verdict.rationale: Rippling documents automatic application of location-based labor policies and tax filing (rippling-docs-26/40/44/45) plus a general claim of automating 'more compliance than any other system' (rippling-docs-47), which implies some proactive risk-flagging. However, there is no explicit evidence of alerts triggered specifically by a new hire, a new location, or a law change being surfaced to a founder as compliance obligations. Missing for 10: explicit alerting workflow tied to new-hire/location/law-change triggers, evidence of founder-facing notifications, and independent confirmation these alerts fire proactively rather than just at payroll run time.
